title: react-dom@15.4.1 breaks build 🚨
body:
Hello lovely humans, [react-dom](https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-dom) just published its new version 15.4.1.
State Failing tests :rotating_light:
Dependency react-dom
New version 15.4.1
Type dependency
This version is **covered** by your **current version range** and after updating it in your project **the build went from success to failure**. As react-dom is a direct dependency of this project **this is very likely breaking your project right now**. If other packages depend on you it’s very likely also breaking them. I recommend you give this issue a very high priority. I’m sure you can resolve this :muscle: Of course this could just be a false positive, caused by a flaky test suite, or third parties that are currently broken or unavailable, but that would be another problem I’d recommend working on.
